blurb: Jobsite Brewing co. is what happens when two carpenters build a brewery in an old Lumber yard. This historic building has a rich history in Stratford as being the home to Pounder Bros Construction, then timber mart, now a family friendly brewery. With a high level of attention to details while building the brewery you can be assured that the same love and dedication is incorporated into the beers brewed here.
